company: Roadmap, 5.0, and future direction slides for Dan

calls.title: Roadmap, 5.0, and future direction slides for Dan
calls.summary: The team reviewed a product analytics strategy aimed at engineers and experimenters, emphasizing incremental improvements and avoiding direct competition with established players like Amplitude. Scott Bailey highlighted the importance of warehouse-native analytics, distinguishing their offering by appealing to customers' desire for data ownership. Investments in feature flagging and experimentation enhancements were prioritized to simplify experiment creation and improve reliability, with notable contributions from the team noted for query performance. Discussions on integrating AI capabilities into their product lines emphasized user experience through features like no-code tools and Slack integration. The roadmap was consolidated around three core themes to enhance clarity in sales messaging and align customer communications.
calls.keywords: product analytics, experimentation, feature flags, roadmap, agent experience, governance
calls.action_items:

Draft the product roadmap and feature slides incorporating discussed themes and send to Scott for review before sharing with Dan (30:50)
Share the finalized roadmap and slides broadly in the sales channel and tag Dan to ensure visibility (32:00)

**Scott Bailey**
Review Elyse’s draft of roadmap and slides and assist with language in the product analytics section (16:50)

Share thematic slide deck on Slack to help frame product themes with agentic experience underlying feature flags, experimentation, and analytics (27:40)
